name: Japan Airlines
h1: Deliver Vision 2035 on one connected layer
lede: JAL's Management Vision 2035 and its enterprise DX investments span IT, operations and the business. Airtable gives those programmes one shared source of truth.
why_h2: A decade-long vision with DX moving fast
why_p: JAL has set long-range growth targets while investing in DX, digital identity pilots and renewed customer services, all of which cross team boundaries.

signals.title: Management Vision 2035 announced
signals.body: JAL set out a ten-year growth vision targeting EBIT of JPY 300 billion by FY2030 and over JPY 350 billion by FY2035.
signals.angle: Long-running portfolios need programme visibility that survives spreadsheet handovers.

signals.title: Investment in A*Quantum for enterprise DX
signals.body: JAL invested in A Star Quantum through its corporate venture capital fund to accelerate enterprise DX and business transformation.
signals.angle: DX portfolios span IT, operations and business units; Airtable connects them.

signals.title: Digital identity transfer trial
signals.body: JAL and Tokyo International Air Terminal tested digital identity for transfer passengers from Haneda to London via Hong Kong under IATA's proof-of-concept programme.
signals.angle: Cross-partner pilots need shared trackers across airports, IT and operations.

signals.title: Domestic services and JAL App renewed
signals.body: JAL renewed services across its domestic network from 1 April 2026, including a redesigned JAL App.
signals.angle: Service launches touch product, marketing and airport operations at once; one system keeps them coordinated.
